transactioncolumncustomfield.description: The destination product identifier used for this line, resolved from the UOM Detail row on this line's item whose Saleable Unit matches the line's unit. This is the join that makes line matching work. Blank on a line the filter drops - such a line never reaches the destination, so it has no identifier there.
